summary: It is time to renew your Medicaid health coverage. You must send back the renewal form and proof of income, or your coverage will end.

deadlines.what: Send back your renewal form and proof of income
deadlines.sourceQuote: Your completed renewal form and income documents must be received by November 15, 2026, or your coverage will end on November 30, 2026.

deadlines.what: Your coverage ends if the form is not received
deadlines.sourceQuote: Your completed renewal form and income documents must be received by November 15, 2026, or your coverage will end on November 30, 2026.

steps: Fill out the renewal form that came with this letter.
Make copies of your last 4 pay stubs.
Mail the form and copies, or turn them in online or in person.
Write down the date you sent them.
Call the number on the letter if you have questions.
